title: Deutsch’s algorithm, one state at a time
objectives: Derive the full ideal circuit state sequence.
Interpret the input-register measurement and query count.
prerequisites: Chapters 5–7: Hadamard interference, joint states, XOR oracle action, phase kickback and bit ordering.
